steps.what: List fields from the business systems
Collaborate with sales on order processes
Integrate logistics with accounting and shipping
Sign the integration note
File the signed integration note
outputs: filed copy of signed integration note v1

tasks.design: A job lists stored order, sales, accounting, and shipping fields in {ERP}. The manager collaborates with the other department and decides the mapping. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}. It does not change the other system.
tasks.previous_blocker: Field lists were rebuilt before each meeting.
tasks.enabler_now: The field names are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The other department still has to agree.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides which fields to join.

ambition.what: Agree a field mapping the week the gap is stored.

tasks.altitude: The manager spends the week on the agreement, not on collecting field names.

evidence.claim: The executive digest says logistics planning is configured route and stock tools, and the manager decides.

assumptions: Field name, source system, and order identifier are stored on the ledger. The ledger produces them. A blank field name is left blank and is not mapped.
Native configuration of the ledger is used before any custom code.
Only the version the manager signed is filed or sent.
A live mapping change is a later signed job. This job only files the note.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining meeting time is still the manager with the other department.

incremental.description: Refresh field name and source system when the ledger layout changes, and drop a mapping the manager has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes field names are incomplete. The high end assumes field name and source system are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Analyze the means of transporting goods.

steps.what: Price each stored mode and volume
Analyze the effective means of transporting products
Choose the efficient means for supplies
Sign the transport means
File the signed transport means
outputs: filed copy of signed transport means v1

tasks.design: A job multiplies stored rates by stored volumes for each mode in {ERP}. The manager analyzes the means of transporting products or supplies and chooses. A later job files the signed choice in {DOCS}. The multiplication is not the choice.
tasks.previous_blocker: Mode costs were rebuilt in a sheet before each study.
tasks.enabler_now: Rates and volumes are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The cheaper mode can still be the wrong means.

ambition.what: Choose a mode the week the volume is stored.

tasks.altitude: The manager spends the week on the choice, not on the multiplication.

evidence.claim: The executive digest says a cost-to-serve figure is plain code on stored quantities and rates.
The executive digest says logistics planning is configured route and stock tools, and the manager decides.

assumptions: Rate, volume, mode, and lane identifier are stored on the ledger. The ledger produces them. A blank rate is not priced and is shown as a gap.
Native configuration of the ledger is used before any custom code.
Only the version the manager signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining study time is still the manager choosing the means.

incremental.description: Refresh rate, volume, and mode when the ledger layout changes, and drop a total the manager has not accepted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes a mode has no stored rate. The high end assumes rate, volume, and mode are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List open logistics and customer issues
Resolve problems on imports and exports
Decide the transportation issue with the customer
Sign the issue decision
File the signed issue decision
outputs: filed copy of signed issue decision v1

tasks.design: A job lists open logistics and customer issues in {HELPDESK}. The manager resolves the transportation, import, or export problem with the people involved. A later job files the signed decision in {DOCS}. It does not close the issue by itself.
tasks.previous_blocker: Open issues were copied out before each call.
tasks.enabler_now: The issue rows are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The customer can still reject the answer.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides how the issue ends.
tasks.altitude: The manager spends the week on the problem, not on finding the list.

reach.task: Act only on the signed decision

evidence.claim: The executive digest says receipts, purchase-order policy and tariff checks are rules, and a person handles a mismatch.
The executive digest says logistics planning is configured route and stock tools, and the manager decides.

assumptions: Issue identifier, shipment identifier, and status are stored on the help record. The help record produces them. A blank shipment identifier is shown as a gap.
Native configuration of the help record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the manager signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time is still the manager resolving the issue.

incremental.description: Refresh issue identifier and shipment identifier when the help record layout changes, and drop a list the manager has not used.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes issue records have no shipment. The high end assumes issue identifier and shipment identifier are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List stored incident rows for procedures
Document standard and emergency operating procedures
Draft procedure sentences from those rows

loop.purpose: Draft the operating procedure from stored incident rows and the manager outline.
loop.input: Stored incident rows and the manager outline.
loop.output: Procedure sentences that each cite a stored incident identifier.
loop.check: Every number matches a stored row, and every claim is a restatement of that row.
loop.stop: Stop when a number or a claim has no row.
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed procedure template cannot tell which stored incident identifier the sentence cites.

steps.what: Check receiving and salvaging claims against rows
Sign the operating procedure
File the signed operating procedure
outputs: filed copy of signed operating procedure v1

tasks.design: A job lists stored incident rows in {DOCS}. The manager outlines the operating procedure for receiving, handling, storing, shipping, or salvaging. A bounded draft cites those record identifiers, and the manager checks that each claim restates a row. A later job files the signed procedure in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Procedures were rewritten from memory and old files.
tasks.enabler_now: The incident rows are already stored, and a draft can cite their identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: A sentence can still describe the wrong handling step.
tasks.altitude: The manager spends the week on the procedure, not on finding the incidents.

evidence.claim: The executive digest says a model drafts a nonconformance that cites record identifiers, and a person signs.

assumptions: Incident identifier, handling step, and product identifier are stored on the document record. The document record produces them. The draft stops when a claim has no row.
Native configuration of the document record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the manager signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining check time is still the manager confirming each claim has a row.

incremental.description: Refresh incident identifier and handling step when the document layout changes, and drop a sentence that cites no row.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many claims have no incident row. The high end assumes each claim cites a stored incident identifier. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The distribution manager spends the week on the floor, the exception, and the signed decision. A stored quantity times a stored rate, a rule on a document field, and filing that decision can move. The manager still directs people and still inspects the warehouse.
reach: A warehouse lead follows only the assignment the manager signed.
A carrier is told only the rate the manager signed.
skills_to_grow: Reject a list that is missing a stored field.
Reject a procedure sentence that has no stored row.
role.ambitious_version: A signed operating decision can be filed the same week, and the manager still owns the floor.
